metin.SexyKO’da rekabeti yıl boyunca canlı tut: The **Season System** that will keep competition alive all year long is starting in SexyKO.
metin.Her sezon, yeni başlayan oyuncuların ana: Each season opens with boosted **EXP • DROP • COIN** rates so new players can catch up with the main server faster.
metin.Sezon tamamlandığında oyuncular gelişiml: When the season ends, players are moved to the **main SexyKO server** together with their progress.
metin.Official **23 Ekim 2026** · sezon açılış: Official **23 October 2026** · seasons open **every 28 days on Friday 22:00** · end / merge **on Monday of the following week 22:00** · times in Turkey time (UTC+3)
